notes: Initial reviewed feature inventory, not an exhaustive normative checklist.
A verified implementation task does not establish UE profile compliance.
Optional features must satisfy their applicable requirements when enabled.

requirements.summary: 确定性纳秒事件、取消与对象销毁
requirements.evidence_note: Virtual deadline/sequence ordering, cancellation and lifetime remain deterministic. Realtime callbacks follow a live injected elapsed clock; late manual progress no longer backdates retransmission timers. Deterministic pre-fix regressions observed10 timer firings and6 PDS requests in one late progress; corrected tests also cover work within callbacks, overdue immediate scheduling and future/backward clock rejection. See REALTIME-PROGRESS.md.

requirements.summary: 现有 SES/PDS/IPDC/TPDC 在虚拟时间下运行
64 端点运行与确定性输出
Ethernet/IPv4/IPv6/原生 UET/UDP 封装
requirements.evidence_note: IPv4/IPv6 native/UDP frames, full configurable native protocol range, entropy and reserved fields tested. Portable default is UDP/4793; native mode requires an explicit protocol number, including 0 and 17. UDP destination supports the full 16-bit range, wrong-port drops, trimming and MAC service-time stamps. UFH/TSS/tunnels and provider FI_ADDR_UET remain open.

requirements.summary: CRC32C、网络序、UDP checksum 掩码、错误拒绝
requirements.evidence_note: Network byte order, corruption, UDP checksum masking and the explicit trimmed-packet CRC exception tested; TSS/UFH cases remain open.

requirements.summary: 标准请求与语义响应编码
PDC基础元组及Job/PID/资源索引组合配置
requirements.evidence_note: Native host configuration supports independent RUD/ROD policies, the base FA/TC/mode tuple and all combinations of JobID, source PID, target PID and resource index. Source PID is local metadata, distinct from the SES matching rank. Full traffic-class groups, reserved resources and conditional SDI mapping remain open; see PDC-MAPPING.md.

requirements.summary: PDS配置范围、MPR编码与状态管理
requirements.evidence_note: Field audit in PDS-CONFIGURATION.md separates required ranges, optional/coalescing conditions and TSS/READ dependencies. Encoded Default_MPR, initial/receive PSN windows and local transmit cache are distinct. Full management/status, reserved pools and remaining conditional fields remain open.

requirements.summary: 选择 ACK、累计 ACK、重复 ACK 与 PSN 回绕
requirements.evidence_note: Selective/cumulative ACK cleanup, strict CACK semantic inference, SACK, idle Clear, peer MPR and asynchronous first ROD ACK order tested. READ/fetch response contracts, remaining control formats and optional coalescing remain open; see PDS-SACK.md and ROD-ACK-ORDER.md.

requirements.summary: ROD 建连、数据和语义响应
requirements.evidence_note: GoBackN, EV/CE/RETX, Probe/Close, initial PSN/SYN bounds, SES admission, first asynchronous ACK order, held-cache query barriers, historical replay and non-trimmable request-class numbered controls tested. READ response ordering, TSS and complete control/error combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 数据/ACK 丢失恢复与有限重试
requirements.evidence_note: Nanosecond RTO, configurable common retry limit 0..15 (15 infinite), wide attempt identities, separate NACK/timeout backoff, delayed retry deduplication/cancellation and MAC timers tested. New_Start_PSN and full READ/TSS/control matrices remain open; see RETRY-TIMING.md and NACK-RECOVERY.md.

requirements.summary: RUD 乱序窗口、重复消除及 SACK
requirements.evidence_note: Per-packet SACK, strict CACK default inference, response queries, guaranteed-error recovery, Probe bitmap/window recovery and wrap tested; optional coalescing and full lifecycle/error combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 无连接 UUD 单包发送与本地完成
requirements.evidence_note: Single-packet local completion, loss without retry, missing receive and no PDC allocation tested.

requirements.summary: 完整 Clear/Close、资源复用与迟到报文
requirements.evidence_note: Normal/lossy initiator close, target Close Request with plain ACK, same-PSN retries, idempotent requests, silent-initiator retry exhaustion, required Close Command CP_ACK and context reuse are tested for ROD/RUD. Full control/negotiation/expected-start and wrap matrix remain open. Plaintext source Start_PSN uses an injected PRNG and >=2^16 local-ID epoch separation; target startup avoids an invalid retired-peer sequence floor (INITIAL-SEQUENCES.md). TSS start negotiation remains unavailable. Idle Clear after default ACKs now releases state without an additional application request; queued requests piggyback instead.

requirements.summary: trimming 检测及 NACK 恢复
requirements.evidence_note: Plain IPv4/IPv6/native/UDP switch trimming, unchanged UDP fields, bounds-only restricted parsing, no PDC creation/SES placement from a trimmed header, normal/last-hop NACK and RUD/ROD recovery tested. Additional loss/resource combinations and TSS/other modes remain open.

requirements.summary: JobID 和 MR/PID 作用域授权
内存键、访问权限、边界与撤销
requirements.evidence_note: Local-placement-only registrations distinguish trusted postings/returned-result authority from incoming RMA key access. Both relative/absolute RMA are denied even with known key and R/W/Atomic rights; exact local identity, bounds, revocation and namespace checks remain. Native SEND/UUD, both READ carriers and cached atomic results still place correctly. Public fi_recv regression reproduced an unauthorized byte99 write with the pre-fix provider binary and now rejects it while delivering posted SEND. Full MR key classes, advanced authorization and profile acceptance remain open; see LOCAL-PLACEMENT.md.

requirements.summary: 多包 WRITE 的真实内存效果及语义完成
requirements.evidence_note: Native streamed WRITE of 4294967295 bytes completes through 524288 original PDS/fabric fragments with verified markers, cleared bytes and retirement; producer queue <=8, ordered receive intervals <=1, sparse pages <=3. Default CTest covers 8 MiB and loss. Full Profile and other operation size guarantees remain open.

requirements.summary: 预投递缓冲区 SEND 与 NO_OP
WRITE IMM 及 SEND/DGRAM 的远端完成数据
requirements.evidence_note: WRITE data creates a standalone RMA completion; SEND/DGRAM data retains the matching receive context and consumes one posting. Zero/max data, late posting and IE tested; complete profile/address/error combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 线上的非取回原子操作
requirements.evidence_note: Signed/unsigned integer widths 8/16/32/64, non-fetching arithmetic/logical/bitwise/write; zero-byte PUT passes normal authority/alignment/bounds and target completion without a memory write. Fetch/CAS now have separate SES-FETCH evidence. FP and complete semantic-control coverage remain open.

requirements.summary: Profile 规定的消息大小及流式接口
真实 libfabric 2.0 provider
requirements.evidence_note: Experimental libfabric 2.0 maps FI_MSG, SEND/DGRAM CQ data, WRITE/WRITE IMM, integer atomics and recovery through the common kernel; standard UET addresses/auth and remaining flags/profile acceptance remain open. Public API tests now verify independent SEND/RW mode selection, mixed-mode FIFO, any-JobID MR registration and both explicit ROD and RUD late-receive recovery. Standard UET addressing and full authorization configuration remain incomplete. Injection API/flags use bounded owned copies and preserve success/error CQ rules through semantic retries; RDM completion thresholds use the explicitly stronger globally-observable point; DGRAM thresholds use local transmit acceptance. Basic nonblocking EQ FIFO/binding is tested; standard UET addressing, full authorization and asynchronous control production remain incomplete. Native SEND/UUD and tagged source criteria use Job-scoped32bit ranks. Public FI_DIRECTED_RECV is opt-in through global/rx hints for RDM SEND/tagged and DGRAM UUD, with two-peer FIFO/source tests, invalid AV rejection, and ignored src_addr when capability is not requested; see DIRECTED-RECEIVE.md.

requirements.summary: NSCC 准入、窗口与反馈闭环
requirements.evidence_note: Original PDS admission/retries, signed ACK byte clock, NSCC law, plaintext trimming, Probe feedback and MAC timestamps implemented. Deterministic incast, multiple flows, CE/trim, asymmetric ECMP and temporary-outage scenarios now export actual per-hop bytes and completion metrics. Full normative/control/fault acceptance remains open; see NSCC.md and NETWORK-EXPERIMENTS.md. Explicit CCC binding now occurs at source PDC allocation and target SYN establishment; control-only lifecycle, failed SYN, PDC capacity refusal, RUD sharing, ROD isolation and teardown tested. Complete TC/reserved-pool resource mapping remains open; see NSCC-LIFECYCLE.md.

requirements.summary: 串行化、队列、丢包、链路故障及 ECMP 行为
requirements.evidence_note: Independent TC queues, byte-deficit round robin, dequeue ECN, true trimming, first-bit timing, serialized random loss and link generations tested. YAML config, per-hop PCAP/index and incast/competition/asymmetric/outage examples implemented. Full M4/Profile acceptance remains open; see NETWORK-EXPERIMENTS.md.

requirements.summary: 多包 READ 与数据响应
requirements.evidence_note: Native RUD/ROD fragmented READ up to 32-bit message length with both reverse-request and large-ACK-threshold multi-packet carriers, exact registered result authority, per-fragment reauthorization, bounded target packet credits/response tokens and coalesced placement. ACK-data re-execution and same-PDC return data tested with loss, ordering, revocation, cancellation, context-pressure rollback and token-direction isolation. Independent early-ACKing SES policy is tested with per-operation source result windows, partial READ MID retirement through graceful connection close, pre-transmit cancellation and unassigned-PDC rejection. Public fi_read/readv/readmsg with private registered local placement, RAW/WAR FIFO ordering, both result-carrier loss paths and CQ/error validation are tested, including independent provider processes. A standard ACK-data READ interoperates with the unchanged pinned reference SES/PDS. Four clean-source 4GiB-1 native READ runs (both carriers, NSCC off/on) actually placed and verified all 4294967295 bytes in 524288 fragments, with producer/result/target packet peaks8, one coverage interval and three sparse pages per end; see READ-BOUNDARY.md. Optimized headers, TSS and RODL remain open; see READ.md.

requirements.summary: 精确/通配 tag 与队列匹配
requirements.evidence_note: Native standard-header opcode0x09 supports full64bit exact/ignore-bit tags and optional32bit Job-level rank, one FIFO among all matching postings, independent Tagged generations and SEND/RMA isolation. RUD/ROD and NSCC tests cover late/unexpected/no-match, zero/truncation, authority snapshots/key reuse, duplicate/lost ACK/reordered SOM, tag changes, and drain. Pinned unchanged reference SES/PDS exchanges exact64bit tagged messages in both directions and checks tagged CQ fields; its API explicitly rejects wildcard tags. Public scalar/vector/msg tagged APIs, inject/data, full tag CQ/error fields and per-space generation recovery are implemented; private automatic tagged receive MRs reject known-key remote WRITE. Public two-provider processes exchange exact64bit tagged messages in both directions. Optimized headers, rendezvous, multi-receive, tagged atomics, TSS and RODL remain open. See TAGGED-MESSAGES.md. Native SEND/UUD and tagged source criteria use Job-scoped32bit ranks. Public FI_DIRECTED_RECV is opt-in through global/rx hints for RDM SEND/tagged and DGRAM UUD, with two-peer FIFO/source tests, invalid AV rejection, and ignored src_addr when capability is not requested; see DIRECTED-RECEIVE.md.

requirements.summary: deferrable send 与 restart
requirements.evidence_note: Native deferrable SEND0x08/TSEND0x0b sources use FEP-scoped unique tokens, one transaction ID/deadline across fresh-MID backoff/restarts, checked RTR identity/ranges and lazy suffix slices. Optional bounded target header capture J=0 reserves exact posted registration with nonzero target token and sends real RUD RTR through original PDS. Both source zero-token re-deferral/J>0 and early/duplicate/invalid RTR are tested with an independent real-PDS SES peer. Native matrices cover zero/MTU/multifragment, NSCC, targeted packet faults, cancellation/deadline/close, revoked/reused MR, truncation, header exhaustion/FIFO, reader failure, PDC lifecycle, token exhaustion/Endpoint replacement and bounded concurrency. Default target retains as-SEND compatibility. Full Profile review, Sync Groups/cross-backoff ordering, TSS and pinned-reference actual RTR interoperability remain open. See DEFERRABLE-TRANSACTIONS.md; feature tests do not claim M5 or Profile completion.

requirements.summary: rendezvous 与 unexpected 消息
requirements.evidence_note: Native registered-buffer rendezvous SEND/TSEND now connects standard24-byte extensions, bounded eager acceptance/header capture, real RUD READ with both carriers, exact source/result MR identity and independent eager/READ completion. Source completion waits for real READ payload ACK/Clear and union coverage; target completion waits for actual placement and eager SOM/EOM/wire holes. Independent source oracle, native expected/late/NSCC matrices, packet faults, cancellation/deadlines/close, MR revoke/reuse, Job/FEP/rank/read-only alias isolation, absolute AnyJob authority, resource pressure/shared FIFO, malformed fields/results and mapped addressing/generation retries are covered. The4GiB-1 logical descriptor/last-byte test is not a full rendezvous transfer. Public RDM SEND/tagged scalar/vector/message/data forms select native rendezvous at a configurable threshold with private source-only registrations, keeping ordinary SEND recovery separately tested. Public expected/late/wildcard, CQ data, bidirectional truncation, revoked alias probes, two-process global deadline and independent RMA continuation are covered. Truncation errors retain SOM CQ data or defer one bounded CQ until delayed SOM/Close. Optimized headers, complete Sync Group/TSS/Profile acceptance and full large rendezvous experiments remain open. See RENDEZVOUS.md.

requirements.summary: 取回原子操作、CAS、数据类型与异常
requirements.evidence_note: Native RUD/ROD one-element fetching atomics and CAS for8/16/32/64/128bit signed/unsigned integers,32B padded dual operands and up to16B returned old values. PDS caches guaranteed results until Clear independently of READ threshold; DEFAULT/CACK cannot replace result data. Tested with NSCC, loss/duplicates, remote modification/revocation after execution, local result revocation and key reuse, remote authority/bounds errors, malformed data ACK/default, and nonzero admitted resource generations. Unchanged pinned reference SES/PDS independently serves64bit fetching SUM and CAS. Public libfabric scalar/vector/message fetching and compare APIs support a single8–128bit integer element; all queries, masked-swap translation, result CQ fields, bad-generation retries with preserved nonzero generation, cached-loss recovery and independent provider processes are tested. Optimized/other datatypes, tagged atomics, RUDI, TSS and RODL remain open; see FETCHING-ATOMICS.md. Zero-byte atomic put/get (§3.4.2.12) use normal MR checks and completion; GET performs one actual zero read, with an empty guaranteed data ACK cached through loss and local snapshot revocation/key reuse checked. See ZERO-ATOMIC.md.

RUDI 无连接、逐包响应与幂等限制
RCCC 接收端信用算法
TFC 信用与重传规则

LLDP 能力协商与不匹配处理
速率/延迟、误码、FEC 延迟与统计抽象
能力、安全域、JobID 与设备统计管理
RODL 双向 PDC、累计确认与错误模型
局部事务头、打包及直接寻址
UFH_16/32、CRC 与 TSS 路径
官方实现的进程级标准报文互通
requirements.evidence_note: Independent processes use unchanged pinned reference SES/PDS and a test-only UDP-frame NIC adapter: WRITE/SEND, uint64 SUM and return SEND, completions and Clear retirement pass. Raw-NIC/veth tests and additional operation/encapsulation/fault combinations remain open.

requirements.summary: 相对/绝对 PID、独立资源索引、generation 与任意 JobID MR 授权
requirements.evidence_note: Native address selection and scope checks pass; optimized/local formats and all key classes remain open. Native SEND/UUD and tagged source criteria use Job-scoped32bit ranks. Public FI_DIRECTED_RECV is opt-in through global/rx hints for RDM SEND/tagged and DGRAM UUD, with two-peer FIFO/source tests, invalid AV rejection, and ignored src_addr when capability is not requested; see DIRECTED-RECEIVE.md.

requirements.summary: 消息完成、PSN 关联和协议驱动的消息 ID 退休
requirements.evidence_note: 66000 exactly-once integer operations cross the 16-bit message-ID space; EOM-scoped default responses, explicit full-length RUD completion and error-path ID leases are checked independently. A delayed RUD SOM fills the last hole after EOM; real partial Clear CPs must retain WRITE/SEND/tagged message state until the actual EOM PSN is cleared. The baseline premature-retirement failure and three-path fix are recorded in RECEIVE-EOM-RETIREMENT.md. Complete byte coverage does not generate receive success before EOM; full/zero payload followed by an independent zero EOM is covered in RUD/ROD WRITE IMM/SEND/tagged and late ROD posting. Zero markers do not form byte intervals; end_of_message_psn names the actual marker. See RECEIVE-END-MARKER.md. Successful EXPECTED results retain DEFAULT through EOM with independent required-delivery/Clear, while tracked unexpected payload retains OVERFLOW/RESPONSE and guaranteed delivery after late placement. Sixteen direct PDS cases verify consistent opcode/list and real REQ_CLEAR; error first-guarantee/best-effort repeats remain covered. See SEMANTIC-RESULTS.md.

requirements.summary: 整条消息保留首错；IE/MSG_ERROR 不访问内存，终止尾部并保留错误完成数据
requirements.evidence_note: Late fragments cannot consume new postings; bounded failure-state exhaustion, IE, MSG_ERROR before SOM in RUD, error CQ header data, local reader exceptions, no reads after error and zero-placement SEND truncation tested. Informational error precedence, complete recovery/generation handling and other header formats remain open. Tracked messages guarantee only the first encountered error; repeated explicit errors are best effort, with cached replay/response-query and next-request Clear tested. Standard requests now reserve bounded message records before PDS receipt; exhaustion produces resource NACKs, with rollback, no premature PDC/SACK and recovery tested. Retransmissions refresh Clear to release older records. Successful EXPECTED results retain DEFAULT through EOM with independent required-delivery/Clear, while tracked unexpected payload retains OVERFLOW/RESPONSE and guaranteed delivery after late placement. Sixteen direct PDS cases verify consistent opcode/list and real REQ_CLEAR; error first-guarantee/best-effort repeats remain covered. See SEMANTIC-RESULTS.md.

requirements.summary: NOOP/NO_NEG 控制包建连、独立 PSN、ACK Request 处理状态
requirements.evidence_note: ROD/RUD control-only opening followed by checked WRITE, SYN/ACK loss and safety delay, 32-byte NO_NEG, unsupported on-off negotiation plain ACK, invalid SYN CP rejection and ACK-request processing/cache/missing/below-Clear/wrap states are exercised. Negotiated features, Probe/Credit/PCM and extended ACK variants remain open. Plaintext source Start_PSN uses an injected PRNG and >=2^16 local-ID epoch separation; target startup avoids an invalid retired-peer sequence floor (INITIAL-SEQUENCES.md). TSS start negotiation remains unavailable. Established data/control SYNs enforce the initial MP_RANGE boundary, including equality, wrap and ROD gap precedence. Initial RUD window refusal allocates no PDC; the first ROD gap retains a PDC and requests Start_PSN before established-SYN checks.

requirements.summary: 有界 ROD unexpected 缓冲、资源代次恢复及最早消息的受限软件重试
requirements.evidence_note: Late/partial receive posting, ordered placement, zero-placement truncation, disabled-generation responses and re-enable, stale generation, SEND/RMA isolation, RUD no-match/manual retry, transport-retirement query and partial receive error on PDC failure are checked. Public API processes cover delayed receive, hidden intermediate errors, bounded retry failure and subsequent RMA. Full MR key classes, ordered/API acceptance and cross-peer recovery matrices remain open.

requirements.summary: 完整 48 位 RKEY、64 位元数据、含零值的命名空间与独立撤销身份
requirements.evidence_note: Native non-optimized application keys cover full 48-bit range, zero Job/PID/key/index and distinct relative Job/PID/index scopes. Absolute selection ignores Job for lookup and rejects ambiguous equal RKEYs, including differing idempotent metadata. SEND/UUD postings pin live registration identity, preventing cross-Job reselection and stale-key rebinding. Duplicate binding, permission fallback and stale/foreign revocation are rejected. Provider declares six RKEY bytes and preserves 64-bit idempotent metadata with optimized fallback. Optimized headers and provider application-assigned key mode remain open.

requirements.summary: 接收端将非匹配 DEFERRABLE_SEND 作为 SEND 处理
requirements.evidence_note: Narrow default receiver compatibility behavior: opcode0x08, token/address separation, posting/NoMatch in both ROD and RUD, explicit retry and header data. Optional native deferral/RTR/restart and tagged transactions are tracked separately by SES-DEFER; this verified fallback does not establish complete deferrable semantics.
